wa_waiis.name: Washington State Immunization Information System (WAIIS)
wa_waiis.description: Immunization coverage data from the Washington State Immunization Information System (WAIIS). Includes vaccination rates for infants, children, preteens, and teens across multiple vaccine types, reported as point-in-time snapshots at the county level. Coverage rates represent the percentage of the assessed population that has received the specified number of doses.
wa_waiis.restrictions: Public domain. Washington State Department of Health data is freely available for public use.
